security_tools.name: shodan
security_tools.notes: The hacker's search engine. Finds exposed devices.

dark_web.name: dread
dark_web.notes: Dark web Reddit alternative, DNM discussions

dark_web.name: asap_market
dark_web.notes: Top-tier security market. Introduced DeadDrop and Maps feature. Enforces strict OPSEC (PGP, 2FA). Anti-scam hunting system. Heavy DDoS protection with rotational mirrors.

special_rules.physical_listings: Must include date, vendor name, and ASAP logo in product photo.
special_rules.digital_listings: No FE for new vendors. Strictly no duplicate or misleading content.
special_rules.vacation_mode: Max 14 days auto-finalize for physical, 3 days for digital.
special_rules.punishment: Confiscate funds and permanent ban for scamming.
special_rules.ops_security: No doxxing, no FUD, no sharing stealth methods.

dark_web.name: torlink
dark_web.notes: Dark web link directory with user profiles

dark_web.name: tor2door_market
dark_web.notes: Modern anonymous market. Features multisig escrow and Finalize Early. Accepts BTC/XMR. 7 mirrors available.

dark_web.name: abacus_market
dark_web.notes: Custom-built marketplace coded from scratch. Features Hansa-style multisig with unlimited transaction broadcasting. Vendor-friendly with auto-import from WHM/ToRReZ. Has translated forum in 10+ languages. 2FA and PGP supported.

dark_web.name: incognito_market
dark_web.notes: Secure and simple marketplace. Focus on safety and user-friendliness. Features emergency rotational links for anti-DDoS protection. Has I2P mirror for additional anonymity.
